newsitem.title: USA: Integrated Systems sees Q1 EPS $0.06-0.07.
newsitem.headline: Integrated Systems sees Q1 EPS $0.06-0.07.

text.p: Integrated Systems Consulting Group Inc on Tuesday said it expected to post first-quarter earnings of between $0.06 and $0.07 per share.
The estimated range falls short of analysts' expectations of $0.10 per share, according to a First Call survey.

Chairman and Chief Executive David Lipson said in a statement that the "anticipated first-quarter earnings softness will result principally from extensions in the system design phase of several large projects."

"Development of the software associated with these projects is now expected to begin during the second and/or third quarter," he added. "We have also experienced a slower-than-anticipated growth in the number of our technical employees."
Integrated Systems is an information services consulting firm that provides software applications development and systems, and network management consulting services.
